tools.name: list_style_profiles
tools.description: List available style profiles (frozen art-direction lever sets). Use one profile per game so every asset matches.

tools.name: list_animation_clips
tools.description: List CC0 animation clips that can be baked into a character GLB.

tools.name: init_project
tools.description: Detect the game engine and write .meshgenie/project.json (style lock + asset paths). Call once per game repo.

project_root.description: Path to the game project root. Defaults to MESHGENIE_PROJECT_ROOT or cwd.

style_profile.description: Style profile name to lock (e.g. lowpoly-heroic).

engine.description: Force engine: unity | godot | three | unreal | generic. Omit to auto-detect.

tools.name: create_concept
tools.description: Generate free/cheap 2D concept images for a character. Returns a job_id; status becomes awaiting_approval when concepts are ready. Style profile is frozen on this job.

style_profile.description: Profile for this job if project is unlocked. Frozen after create.

wait.description: If true, block until concepts are ready (local DEMO). Default false.

tools.name: build_asset
tools.description: Build rigged animated GLB from a concept job. Does NOT accept style_profile — inherits the profile frozen at create_concept. Charges credits when enforcement is on.

image_index.description: Which concept image to lift to 3D (0-based). Default 0.

wait.description: If true, block until ready (local DEMO). Default false.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a job. Returns status, stage-based progress, poll_after_ms, and artifact paths when ready.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job.

tools.name: generate_asset
tools.description: Full pipeline: prompt → rigged animated GLB. Async by default (returns job_id). Pass wait=true only for local DEMO sync.

wait.description: Default false. true = block until GLB (DEMO).

tools.name: add_character_to_game
tools.description: Intent tool with multi-turn session. action=start creates a concept job; action=approve builds; action=status polls; action=install copies GLB+receipt into project paths (local MCP only).

auto_approve_concept.description: If true on start, build immediately after concept (power users).
